(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))) 4))))
    (define (marker-color frame)
      (let ((vals
              (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v (obj-color frame)))))
                      (for*/list ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (obj-r2 frame))]
                                  [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1) (obj-c2 frame))])
                        (at g r c)))))
        (if (empty? vals) 1 (first vals))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([frame (in-list (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0)))])
      (let ((marker (marker-color frame)) (border (obj-color frame)))
        (for*/fold ([acc out])
                   ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (obj-r2 frame))]
                    [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1) (obj-c2 frame))])
          (set-cell acc r c
                    (if (= (modulo (+ (- r (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1))
                                      (- c (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1))) 2) 0)
                        marker
                        border)))))))
